description: Analyze a biometric attendance device export (ZKTeco, Hikvision, Dahua, Anviz, Suprema, FingerTec, Matrix COSEC, eSSL and similar; CSV, Excel or text, English or Arabic headers). Returns, per employee: days present, estimated absent days, late days and missing punches, plus the detected column mapping. Free, no account. Limits: 5 MB per file; the free analyzer allows 3 distinct files per 30 days per network address. An encrypted copy of the file is kept for up to 90 days to improve the analyzer, then deleted automatically; a result summary is kept for 7 days behind an unguessable link. Absent days are estimates for review, not confirmed absences. If the file cannot be read the tool returns isError with the analyzer's refusal reason.

calendar.description: Set only if the analyzer asks to confirm the date calendar.

content_base64.description: The attendance export file, base64-encoded. At most 5 MB decoded. Use this OR csv_text.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code of the company (AE, KW, SA, BH, QA, OM). Used only for coarse usage statistics.

csv_text.description: The attendance export pasted as CSV/TSV text, header row first. Use this OR content_base64.

filename.description: Original file name with extension (.csv, .xlsx, .xls, .txt, .tsv, .dat). Required with content_base64.

flex_window_end.description: Latest allowed start time (HH:mm) for flex_window mode.

holidays.description: Public-holiday dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to exclude from working days.

required_hours.description: Required daily hours for the flex modes.

schedule_mode.description: fixed (default): late after shift_start. flex_window: late after flex_window_end. hours_only: only required hours matter.

sheet.description: Worksheet name for multi-sheet Excel files.

shift_start.description: Shift start, HH:mm 24-hour. Lateness is measured against it (10-minute grace).

weekend_days.description: Weekly off days as weekday numbers, Sunday=0 ... Saturday=6 (for example [5,6] for Friday and Saturday).

name: analyze_attendance_file
title: Analyze an attendance device export
